title: Filiform
summary: FIL'IFORM, noun [Latin filum, a thread, and form.] Having the form of a thread or filament; of equal thickness from top to bottom; as a filiform style or peduncle.

inlines.v: FIL'IFORM, noun [Latin filum, a thread, and form.] Having the form of a thread or filament; of equal thickness from top to bottom; as a filiform style or peduncle.
